description: This Java class 'SavingsProductRequestFactory' provides factory methods to create default 'PostSavingsProductsRequest' objects with preset savings product parameters for testing purposes. It acts as a utility to generate standardized test data related to savings products in the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsProductRequestFactory
classes.description: A utility class for creating default savings product request objects for testing.

methods.name: defaultSavingsProductRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a default 'PostSavingsProductsRequest' object with preset values for savings product properties.
